tax.text: He opposed a tax plan he said would cut taxes for the wealthy while reducing funding for health care, education and public safety.
tax.quote: the GOP plans to provide tax breaks for billionaires while slashing health care, education and public safety

wages.text: He voted for a $15 federal minimum-wage amendment and said raising the wage should remain a priority.
wages.quote: I voted for this amendment to underscore my belief that raising the minimum wage must remain a top congressional priority.

trade.text: He opposed broad steel and aluminum import tariffs, citing higher costs for consumers and businesses, while supporting trade enforcement against unfair practices.
trade.quote: These tariffs will significantly increase input costs for small businesses, put homeownership further out of reach for Virginians, and threaten good-paying manufacturing jobs across America.

debt.text: He called for strengthening Social Security and Medicare while also seeking a balanced long-term fiscal solution.
debt.quote: We need to work together to strengthen Social Security and Medicare so they can still be here for future generations.

housing.text: He championed legislation to increase housing supply and encourage localities to address zoning and land-use barriers to development.
housing.quote: will help get more housing built, expand access to homeownership, and make sure federal programs are doing their job effectively.

schools.text: He voted to block a measure he said threatened public school funding and has supported legislation to help modernize school buildings.
schools.quote: not ones that threaten to defund public schools and gut world-class American colleges and universities.

safety.text: He has supported funding for law enforcement as well as prevention, behavioral health response and community-based crime reduction programs.
safety.quote: law enforcement officers, behavioral health professionals, and community partners receiving the tools and training they need to respond effectively to public safety crises.

immigration.text: He supports comprehensive immigration reform with a pathway to citizenship and enforcement focused on people who pose threats to communities.
immigration.quote: the path forward lies in a comprehensive reform that combines a meaningful pathway to citizenship with secure borders

guns.text: He has sponsored legislation to expand background checks to gun sales and supported additional gun violence prevention measures.
guns.quote: sponsored two bills aimed at protecting Virginians from gun violence through expanded background checks on gun sales and banning military-style assault weapons.

abortion.text: He has supported legislation to codify abortion rights and said he would continue working to protect access to legal abortion.
abortion.quote: I will continue working to protect needed access to safe, legal abortion.

gender.text: He opposed a federal measure barring transgender athletes from women’s sports and said decisions about integrating transgender students should be left to parents, educators and state athletic associations.
gender.quote: leave the decision of how to best integrate transgender students into sports in the hands of parents, educators and state athletic associations

health.text: He introduced a health care bill that would create a public insurance option and expand Medicaid coverage.
health.quote: There is still a lot of work to be done to get to universal coverage, but my comprehensive Health CARE Act includes life-saving provisions to meaningfully improve health care and lower costs

energy.text: He supports reducing emissions and investing in clean energy while also emphasizing affordable energy and domestic production.
energy.quote: He supports an all-of-the-above energy strategy that invests in clean energy, strengthens domestic production, modernizes the electric grid, and reduces reliance on foreign fuel sources.

voting.text: He introduced and backed legislation supporting same-day registration, early voting and mail voting.
voting.quote: legislation to improve access to the ballot for Americans, advance commonsense federal election standards and campaign finance reforms, and protect American democracy.

immigration.text: He supports secure borders while making legal immigration easier.
immigration.quote: We must keep our borders secure while making legal immigration for those seeking the American Dream an easier process.

guns.text: He says he will defend the right to bear arms and oppose efforts to infringe on it.
guns.quote: Our Constitutional right to keep and bear arms is key to the security of freedom and individual liberty. I will defend our rights to citizen self-defense and fight any effort to infringe on that right.
